title: Empty-frequency coefficient of a centered indicator
statement: For each natural number $q$, let $A$ be the Gaussian-threshold upper-tail set in the chosen tail dimension, and let $m$ be its uniform mass on that sign cube. The Fourier coefficient at the empty frequency of the function $x\mapsto 2\mathbf{1}_A(x)-1$ is $2m-1$.
